AI & Article Engine

How Zerogah transforms real experiences into behavioral knowledge

The Zerogah AI Pipeline

1. Experience Collection

Users log their real experiences with structured context — triggers, reactions, consequences, and behavioral roots.

2. Pattern Extraction

AI identifies recurring behavioral patterns, psychological traps, and emotional cycles across thousands of narratives.

3. Dataset Structuring

Experiences are converted into machine-readable JSON datasets with causal analysis and pattern tagging.

4. Article Synthesis

The AI engine combines clustered datasets to generate deep, evidence-based articles on human behavioral patterns.
